records.name: Cloudflare Clairic
records.tagline: Cloudflare's AI model for fast, cheap data extraction
records.description: Clairic is Cloudflare's new AI model for extracting structured information without generating tokens. Give it messy text or images, and it returns typed values like names, dates, amounts, calculations, and estimates in a single pass, with confidence scores. Built for developers who need faster, cheaper data processing than traditional LLM calls. Available in preview on Workers AI at $0.10 per million input tokens, with open weights planned.

records.name: DotMD
records.tagline: Review your AI agent's Markdown specs like a pull request
records.description: Your AI agents write the specs, plans and docs. DotMD is a native Mac Markdown app where you review them like a pull request: comment on exact lines, the agent fixes them over MCP, and you accept every change. Also a fast reader and editor: Mermaid, math, code, version history, search, PDF export. Everything stays on your Mac. Free to read.

records.name: Product Hunt Visual Launch Editor
records.tagline: See your launch as you build it
records.description: See your Product Hunt launch come to life as you build it! The new visual editor lets you edit your launch in fewer steps while while automatically saving your draft. You can simply click the name, tagline, gallery or makers to edit them in place. A checklist shows what's required and what will help your launch stand out, and clicking a checklist item will take you straight to the field that needs work. Drafts, scheduled launches and live launches now all use the same editor.

records.name: Dots
records.tagline: A customizable workspace built into your Mac's notch
records.description: Meet Dots, a customizable workspace built into your Mac's notch. Most notch apps focus on music and notifications. Dots goes further by helping you access your favorite apps, websites, and shortcuts without constantly switching windows. Watch videos while working, take scrolling screenshots, use voice commands, and more. Whether you're studying, coding, or creating, Dots adapts to your workflow. Free to get started. No subscriptions.

records.name: Termi Protocol
records.tagline: Watch AI agents code in 3D and hand off the work
records.description: Termi is a 3D room where your real coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, OpenCode and more) work at their own desks. You watch every file read, command and edit live, not a scrolling log. New since our first launch: when an agent hits a usage, rate or context limit, Termi saves its goal, changed files, errors and todos, then hands the work to an agent on another model. A boss agent splits one goal across your team. Deleted agents go to a trash. Now on macOS, Windows and Linux.

records.name: Gerty
records.tagline: Private ChatGPT alternative that sets itself up on your Mac
records.description: Gerty is a private AI assistant that runs entirely on your Mac. It measures your Mac, picks the best open models for each job (chat, writing, code, understanding and making pictures), downloads them and sets them up as one assistant. No terminal, no setup. It works with your documents, mail and calendar, you can ask it out loud, and it shows you every change before it makes it. No account, no cloud, works offline. CHF 49 once for 3 Macs, 7-day free trial.

records.name: FLUX 3 Max
records.tagline: fal’s FLUX 3 Max: 10-second AI video in about 12 seconds
records.description: FLUX 3 Max is fal’s post-trained text-to-video and image-to-video model, built with Black Forest Labs on the FLUX 3 base. fal says it generates a 10-second 720p clip in about 12 seconds, around 10x faster than FLUX 3. It is tied for #1 on a preliminary Artificial Analysis image-to-video board. Pricing is $0.0425 per second of video through November 7 (list $0.17), with a playground and API.

records.name: MOVO AI
records.tagline: The world's first long-form video agent for mobile
records.description: MOVO AI is the world’s first AI video agent for long-form creation that works right from your phone. It also works on the web. Shoot, upload, or start with an idea, then tell MOVO AI what you want. MOVO plans, creates, refines, keeps characters and scenes consistent, and brings the whole video together. Lock your phone and MOVO keeps working. Come back to review or make changes through chat. No prompt gymnastics. No canvas-heavy workflows. No manual clip stitching.

records.name: Peras
records.tagline: Pause Claude Code and Codex before they burn your week
records.description: Peras puts a line in your Claude Code and Codex week. Set it (peras set weekly 85 pause) and once usage crosses it, the agent's next tool call is refused with a plain reason, so one long task can't burn the rest of your week. Resume whenever you want, from the terminal or the menu bar. Opt-in: your agents can be told their own usage. The CLI and hooks are free and MIT. The native Mac menu bar app is €4.99 once.

records.name: ElevenLabs Realtime
records.tagline: Realtime voice agent models with 570ms to first audio
records.description: Eleven Realtime is ElevenLabs’ new family of speech-to-speech models for voice agents. Speech recognition, turn-taking, the LLM and the voice are tuned end-to-end. v1 Mini is built for natural conversation, v1 Max for complex tasks, with 620ms and 570ms to first audio. It supports 90+ languages and works in ElevenAgents or through an OpenAI-compatible Realtime API, so you only change the endpoint and model name.

records.name: Inyon
records.tagline: Answer your coding agents from your phone
records.description: Inyon shows the coding agents already running in tmux on your machines (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Copilot CLI, Antigravity) as chats on your phone or in a browser. When one asks something, you answer with a tap and it's typed into the same pane, so nothing changes when you sit back down. No account and nothing to host: pair the Android app by QR code and it reaches your computers over an end-to-end encrypted tunnel or your VPN. Free, open source, MIT.

records.name: Headroom
records.tagline: Your Mac on iPhone Duo: fold it, and the keyboard appears
records.description: Control your Mac from iPhone, iPad or another Mac. Headroom is a Screen Sharing client: remote access with nothing to install on the Mac, no account, no server in between. On iPhone Duo it changes with every pose: half open, Mac on top, keyboard below.

records.name: Truffle
records.tagline: Fix messy tags, covers and duplicates in your Mac library
records.description: Truffle recognizes each track by its sound and checks eight sources to fix titles, artists, albums, genres, covers, tempo and key. Works with Apple Music, local folders, rekordbox, Serato and Traktor. Nothing is written until you confirm.

records.name: Ovren Live Preview
records.tagline: See your product change live before it ships
records.description: Describe a change in plain words. Ovren writes the code on a safe copy of your project and gives you a live preview of every frontend change — your real page, with the change on it. Click through it, approve it, and your team merges the pull request.

records.name: Agent Hunt
records.tagline: Live rankings of the tools AI agents use most
records.description: Agent Hunt is a live leaderboard of the tools AI agents actually use. Every place is earned by real calls agents make through Monid.

records.name: Plango
records.tagline: Use AI to defend against AI
records.description: Secure your Mac while building with AI. Plango monitors AI coding agents, protects sensitive files and secrets, blocks suspicious network activity, scans projects for vulnerabilities, and gives you control over what your agents can access. Powered by an on-device AI security model. Private by default.

records.name: Instant Search
records.tagline: The fastest, most precise local AI Search for your files.
records.description: Instant is the first accurate local AI file search that uses the latest embedding models to find the exact file (and page) with the content you’re looking for with a 95% hit rate.

records.name: Bloblings
records.tagline: A pet for every Claude Code session
records.description: Every Claude Code and Codex thread gets a pet that acts out its work and shows when it needs you. One click opens the thread. Threads pass notes and work as a team, and you see every one. Free, native, and nothing leaves your Mac.

records.name: Dots Phone
records.tagline: A phone-calling plugin for OpenAI Dots
records.description: Dots Phone is an independent plugin for OpenAI Dots. Give Dots a phone task: it prepares a brief, makes the call, asks Codex for missing details when needed, and reports the result. Self-hosted with your OpenAI and Twilio accounts.

records.name: Context Engine
records.tagline: One memory for your AI agents and human team members.
records.description: Context Engine is one memory for your AI agents and your team. Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Claude Code save to it as they work, and the people on your team read it, ask it questions and add files. Free to start.

records.name: Monish
records.tagline: Your AI agents, live on your iPhone lock screen
records.description: Paste one line into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, n8n or any script. Your agent can then put live progress on your lock screen, ping you when it's done, and ask before it deploys, sends or spends: Approve or Deny from the notification. Free, no account.

records.name: Dub Startup Program
records.tagline: Launch your partner-led growth program
records.description: Launch your partner program, track every referral, and reward the people helping you grow. Get 50% off your first year of Dub.

records.name: Polylane for Cloudflare
records.tagline: An AI on-call engineer for your Cloudflare apps
records.description: Polylane catches issues across your Cloudflare apps, follows the connections between Workers, databases, queues and storage, and investigates the root cause using your code, logs and recent changes. When the fix is in your code, it opens a pull request for review. Connect with one read-only Cloudflare token.

records.name: ShogunAI
records.tagline: Your personal AGI on your pc
records.description: An AI assistant that remembers your work and helps with meeting prep, search, writing and follow-ups. Try ShogunAI for Mac free for 7 days.

records.name: SpeakRemix
records.tagline: Rewrite English as Shakespeare, Old English, pirate or Gen Z
records.description: SpeakRemix rewrites everyday English in 9 voices with AI, from Shakespeare and Old English to pirate and Gen Z, and back again. Its Old English is written as Old English, with þ and æ, not Shakespeare with extra e's, and every AI result is marked as an approximation. It also has instant converters for runes, ogham, hieroglyphs, Morse code (with sound), binary and braille, plus 31 copy-and-paste fancy fonts. Free, no sign-up.

records.name: ByteSend
records.tagline: Send and receive email. Open source, pay as you go
records.description: ByteSend is an open-source email platform. Send transactional and marketing email by API, SMTP or SDK, and now receive it too, with webhooks, an inbox and forwarding. DMARC reports, test mode and 5,000 free emails a month. Self-host or use our cloud.

records.name: My Startup Story
records.tagline: A 100% free startup simulator that's brutally hard
records.description: Build a startup and try to keep it alive. Hire a team, ship products, manage cash, pay taxes and weigh funding against equity. A brutally hard business simulator for iOS, in English and Spanish. 100% free. No subscriptions or in-app purchases.

records.name: APEXGUIDE
records.tagline: Virtual Race Track Simulator & Guide
records.description: APEXGUIDE is a free virtual race track simulator for your phone, tablet or desktop. Drive circuits and explore corner-by-corner track day guides.

records.name: Prospect Cheap - AI-Powered Lead Finder
records.tagline: Scrape leads from 8+ sources with our AI-powered scrapers.
records.description: Prospect Cheap is the best affordable b2b prospects scraper platfrom with over 8 scrapers. We provide MCP server access so that you can use our platform in our favouite tools like Claude Code, Claude, Codex, Cursoe and others. We have powerful REST API that you can use in n8n, Make and Zapier. We are adding free email marketing feature where you can do all the email marketing stuff without any cost except your mail boxes charge.

records.name: What Cat Breed
records.tagline: Find out which breed your cat looks like from one photo
records.description: Upload a photo of your cat and see the three closest of 31 breeds, or whether it is a classic house cat. Our own model, trained on 65,000 cat photos. The photo is analyzed in memory and never stored. Free, no sign-up, with a page on every breed.

records.name: LiquidNotch
records.tagline: macos, macbook, notch, apple, design, app, live, image
records.description: LiquidNotch brings your notch to life, making it fluid, interactive and the perfect companion for work and everything else. Notifications, music, volume, files and devices, right in your Mac's notch. Try it free for 3 days, then get a lifetime license for €4.99.

records.name: SocialSpider AI
records.tagline: Create, schedule, and grow social content with AI
records.description: SocialSpider AI is an agentic AI platform that grows your social media presence AND your AI visibility. Autonomous agents create on-brand content and engineer it to be cited and recommended by ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Grok, and Perplexity. Two growth engines, one AI team.

records.name: MakeDecks
records.tagline: Turn any notes, file or link into an editable deck
records.description: Drop in notes, a PDF, Word or Excel file, an old deck or a link. MakeDecks asks a few quick questions, builds a designed deck, and lets you edit it in the browser. Download a fully editable PowerPoint or PDF. Free, no watermark.

records.name: AI-Powered Lead Generation Chatbots
records.tagline: Train an AI chatbot on your site. Capture leads 24/7
records.description: Custom AI chatbots that qualify leads and book meetings. Trained on your business. 14-day free trial, no credit card required.

records.name: FrameCap
records.tagline: Give your AI eyes to watch YouTube
records.description: Paste a YouTube link into ChatGPT and it never sees the screen, only the captions at best. FrameCap fixes that. One click captures the timestamped transcript plus sharp frames of the screen (every 1–15 seconds, up to 4K) and opens ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Perplexity with a PDF and a ready prompt. AI Agents mode downloads a ZIP for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. Runs fully in your browser: no account, no servers, no tracking. Free.

records.name: Colabio
records.tagline: Time tracking that shows the work, not just the hours
records.description: Colabio connects every tracked hour to its project, task and daily update. Desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux, timesheets, invoices, project budgets and a read-only MCP connector so you can ask Claude or ChatGPT about your team. Visible, never hidden.

records.name: Cynota
records.tagline: Rank in both Google search and AI answers plus more
records.description: Cynota is designed to bridge the gap between classic search visibility and AI-driven answer engines. It helps marketers and site owners analyze, optimize, and track their content so they don't just rank on Google—they get cited and recommended by AI models too. What you can do with it: Dual Optimization: Optimize your content structure for both keyword algorithms and LLM retrieval. AI Answer Tracking: See where and how your brand appears across major AI answer engines.

records.name: BluePetal Studio
records.tagline: Websites shaped around how your business works
records.description: Build a web presence around how your business works. Choose modules for offerings, hours, photos, schedules, reviews, service areas, and inquiries. Manage leads, review useful content pages, and publish updates from your dashboard. Growth adds a customer chat assistant and custom request forms. Hosting and HTTPS are included, with support for your own domain. Try a free private preview without an account or card; subscribe to save and publish.

records.name: Figma code layers
records.tagline: Design, code and specs together on one Figma canvas
records.description: Figma’s code layers put working code on the design canvas, next to the designs. Create one from a frame, a GitHub repo, a webpage via Chrome extension, or by asking the Figma agent. Compare options side by side, and turn a code layer’s states back into editable layers. Figma Specs add design and technical requirements on the canvas, and Payload connects data to Make. Public beta.

records.name: AI Video Editor
records.tagline: Edit existing videos with text prompts
records.description: Upload a 1–15 second MP4, describe one change to its color, background or visual style, and compare the original and edited videos side by side. Try a draft before generating a final version, save results, and reuse prompts for new variants. Credits are shown before generation.

records.name: DepositSafe
records.tagline: Your rental deposit, held safe until move-out
records.description: Rental deposit escrow for residential tenancies in Ireland: deposits are held until move-in, giving tenants greater peace of mind and landlords 0.5% cashback, subject to the applicable terms.

records.name: OkeyStay
records.tagline: Discover vacation rentals with AI-powered assistance
records.description: OkeyStay is an international holiday rental discovery platform helping property managers reach travellers through search engines and AI-powered assistants. We import property listings from supported platforms and optimize their content for search visibility and AI discovery. Our remote MCP server enables compatible AI tools to search stays, retrieve listing details, check availability and pricing, and prepare booking links.

records.name: The Slate
records.tagline: The best way to track your favourite movie and TV talent.
records.description: Never miss a movie or TV show from your favourite talent! The Slate is the unique and easy way to keep track of upcoming movie and TV projects from your favourite actors, writers, directors, or producers. Simply add them to your favourites and see their upcoming work listed in your own personal project Slate. New in v1.2: – iPadOS, macOS, and watchOS support. – Ask Siri AI to display Your Slate, add new favourites and more. – Create your own custom shortcuts with The Slate's native actions.

records.name: SoWhatify
records.tagline: Not just what happened. Why it matters to you.
records.description: Every news app tells you what happened. SoWhatify tells you why it matters to you. Describe your situation once, then click on any article to see what it means for your job, your portfolio or your company. Free, private, with 280+ templates or create your own.

records.name: Dealio
records.tagline: Every promo from 65 Belgian stores — now inside your AI
records.description: Dealio collects 100,000+ promotions from 65 Belgian stores every morning (supermarkets, DIY, electronics, drugstores, fashion) and works out the real discount per item, whether it's 1+1, 2nd at half price or 3 for €10. Filter by store, category or discount size, and browse buying guides and meal ideas built on this week's promos. It's AI-native too: connect Claude or ChatGPT to its public MCP server (dealio.be/mcp) and get live answers with links. Free, no account needed.

records.name: RectoVerso
records.tagline: Flashcards that unfold.
records.description: You open the phone, and the answer comes out a little at a time. Stop when you know it. How far you peeked is the rating, so you never decide if a card was Hard or Good. On other iPhones, slide the answer up. Brings your Anki decks along. Pay once, no account.

records.name: Ironclad: Password Manager
records.tagline: Your passwords. Your device. Your control.
records.description: Your passwords. Your device. Your control. Ironclad is a privacy-focused password manager designed to keep your encrypted password vault on your device. Store your passwords securely, generate strong credentials, unlock your vault with biometrics, identify weak or reused passwords, and check for compromised passwords without sending your actual passwords over the network. Keep your passwords organized in an encrypted vault designed around local-first storage.

records.name: Ember: Markdown Notes
records.tagline: Capture, write, and connect ideas with Markdown.
records.description: Ember is a native Markdown notes app for iPhone and iPad. Write in a live editor with tables, checklists, code, math, and Mermaid diagrams. Type a hex code like #E8743B and it appears in that color. Connect ideas with @ mentions, nested #tags, and Daily Notes, and search text inside PDFs and images. Prompt Vault saves your AI prompts with {{variables}} you fill in before copying. Unlimited standard notes and iCloud sync are completely free. The Mac app is in TestFlight.

records.name: Task Mafia
records.tagline: Your people. Your agents. One crew.
records.description: Capture a task on your phone. Share it with family, assign it to a person, or delegate it to your own connected agent. Task Mafia gives you private conversations, agent questions and a clear handoff for human review, alongside shared lists, a calendar and a web workspace. External agents use their own tools and scheduler; connecting one alone does not start automation. Free on iPhone, iPad and web, with optional Crew.

records.name: Your Trusted Electrician
records.tagline: Your Trusted Electrician in Mississauga, Scarborough Toronto
records.description: Need an electrician you can actually trust? TGS Electrical serves homeowners and businesses across Mississauga, Scarborough, and Toronto. Breaker issues? Dimming lights? Panel upgrades? EV chargers? They'll get it done right the first time. No shortcuts. No surprises. Just honest work from people who care.

records.name: connect-chat
records.tagline: "connectivity with world will bring us together"
records.description: Need a quick video call or file share with friends, gamers, or classmates? Avoid sharing personal info, Discord IDs, or Zoom/Meet invites. This lightweight web platform offers instant communication. No downloads, just create a room and chat. Forget about generating complex, messy links. You can connect instantly by simply entering a shared room code. Once inside, text, send voice notes, and make high-quality video or voice calls directly from your browser. everything of this without adstext!!

records.name: ChaseKit
records.tagline: Polite-to-firm invoice reminders with real late-fee math
records.description: ChaseKit turns an overdue invoice into the right reminder at the right firmness. Enter amount, due date and client region — it works out late charges using actual UK statutory interest, EU late-payment rules or your contract rate, and writes an email plus a WhatsApp version. Friendly at day 3, final-notice at day 30. 100% in-browser: no sign-up, your data never leaves the page. Free generator + Pro Kit ($19 one-time): 12-step sequence, letter before action, contract clauses, invoice tracker.

records.name: WaterfallHikes.com
records.tagline: Waterfall hikes with live stream flow and LiDAR terrain
records.description: Explore waterfall hikes across the US and Canada with live stream-gauge data, 7-day flow outlooks, trail guides, 3D terrain, and alerts when nearby waterfalls are running high.

records.name: Securityplushrms Software
records.tagline: Complete Workforce & Payroll for Security
records.description: Unlike generic HR platforms, Security Plus HRMS is purpose-built for security and facility management firms to handle complex field operations. What Makes It Stand Out: • Multi-Site Attendance: Real-time, geo-tagged shift tracking across remote client sites. • Custom Billing & Payroll: Automated site-wise billing, complex OT, ESI/PF compliance, and NEFT payout generation. • Asset & License Control: Automated PSARA/gun license expiry alerts and uniform inventory tied to salary deductions.

records.name: PresIdea
records.tagline: Turn your thesis or paper PDF into a presentation
records.description: Upload your thesis, paper, or report as a PDF. PresIdea builds slides in the structure your examiners expect for that document type, with speaker notes and a script, in your document's language. Edit, then export to PDF or PowerPoint. Free to try, no card.

records.name: CovioIQ
records.tagline: Insurance broker CRM for policies, renewals and follow ups
records.description: CovioIQ is a CRM for Canadian insurance brokers. Keep clients, policies, opportunities, documents and tasks together. Renewals appear 90 days before expiry, with a churn risk score and the reasons behind it. Ask Alex questions about your own records, then review the answer and take action yourself. English and French workflows support Canadian brokerages.

records.name: D-Ark 25th Color Evolution Fan Guide
records.tagline: Unofficial Digimon D-Ark 25th map, cards & FAQ
records.description: D-Ark 25th Color Evolution Fan Guide is a bilingual (English + Traditional Chinese) unofficial companion for Digimon’s D-Ark 25th Color Evolution virtual pet. Explore a ~50-area map, browse cards, read FAQ and walkthrough-style notes, plus a handful of original articles. Built for players who want clear reference pages in one bookmark. Not affiliated with Bandai or Digimon. No full novel text. Credits community research where used. https://www.d-ark25th.com

records.name: Pupnik
records.tagline: Turn your dog walk into a GPS treasure hunt.
records.description: Pupnik is a free iPhone app that turns the daily dog walk into a real-world treasure hunt. Start a GPS-tracked walk, find bones, balls and rare toys hidden along your route, earn XP and watch your dog level up from New Pup to Goodest Pup. A daily streak, a weekly leaderboard of minutes walked near you, Live Activity and Dynamic Island updates while you walk, Home Screen widgets, Siri Shortcuts and optional Apple Health sync. Unlimited walks, XP, levels, finds and weekly rankings are free.

records.name: SkillDash
records.tagline: The free skill library your AI agent can use
records.description: SkillDash helps AI agents find the right skill without digging through GitHub repos. Search 5,126 source-pinned skill folders, inspect instructions and licenses, and install complete folders with checksum checks. One free public MCP endpoint plus an npm CLI, with plugin and tool discovery and free community submissions. Humans can browse too. No API key for public discovery.

records.name: ASO Engine - App Store Optimization Tool
records.tagline: Keyword Research, Metadata Translation & Price Localization
records.description: The best App Store optimization workspace, built for Mac. Discover keywords, research competitors, and track rankings across countries. Translate metadata with your own OpenAI key and review worldwide pricing, all in one native app.

records.name: Chanson Personnalisée
records.tagline: AI personalized songs to gift, in French
records.description: Chanson Personnalisée creates personalized songs as gifts for birthdays, weddings, declarations, thank-yous, births and tributes. Share a name, your memories and the little details that are yours; our AI-assisted studio writes custom poetic lyrics from your story and produces a complete, high-fidelity song (MP3). You review the lyrics before paying, get a private listening page for 24 hours with one free revision, and receive the final song by email within 24 hours. French-first, one-time price.

records.name: Doja Cat Juicy AI Dance Generator
records.tagline: Turn Your Photo into a Pink Studio Dance Video
records.description: Cast your photo as the lead in a 15-second, 9:16 pink studio dance video with newly generated vocals and music. Your photo guides the performer and outfit; no prompt or recording is needed. Choose Basic (480p/720p) or Pro (up to 1080p), review the paid credit quote, then generate and download an MP4. By VidMake AI. Independent template with no artist affiliation or endorsement. Excludes the Juicy recording, lyrics and Doja Cat’s voice. Likeness, clothing and lip timing may vary.

records.name: Postplan
records.tagline: Easy toolchain for agents to upload HTML and static assets
records.description: Postplan is an easy-to-use platform to let AI agents easily upload HTML artifacts and static assets. Agents can write HTML blazingly fast, so the ability to iterate shouldn't be bottlenecked by tooling — Postplan removes that. Agents can read and write to your Postplan just with curl, so you don't need custom tooling. Postplan comes with agent skills that can steer agents to work according to your workflows. More importantly, Postplan is open-source, so you can own your content and assets.

records.name: boardCache
records.tagline: Your ideas on infinite, local-first, E2E encrypted boards.
records.description: boardCache is your collection of infinite canvas boards for references, inspiration, research, and plans. Pin images, videos, documents, markdown, links, webpages, and more. Draw connections, add timelines, storyboards, task lists and projects when you need structure. Offline-first with optional E2E encrypted sync. The built-in assistant reads your board and acts on it. The desktop app is an MCP server, so agents can build boards too. For web, Mac, Windows and Linux, with a browser clipper.

records.name: Florence by Aldebron
records.tagline: Manage products, inventory, customers and orders simply.
records.description: Florence is a simple boutique management app designed for clothing businesses. Manage your product catalogue, track inventory, organize customer details, handle orders, and coordinate your team, all in one place. Whether you're starting a new boutique or streamlining an existing business, Florence helps you spend less time on daily admin and more time creating, serving customers, and growing your brand. Explore boutiques and browse clothing catalogues, too.

records.name: OnyxPDF
records.tagline: 50 PDF tools that never upload your files
records.description: Every 'free PDF tools' site uploads your file to their server — your contracts, bank statements and ID scans sit on a stranger's computer for a retention period you can't verify. OnyxPDF removes the server: 50 PDF and image tools run 100% in your browser via WebAssembly — merge, split, compress, convert, OCR in 7 languages, true redaction, signing, and AES-256 encryption, all on your device. No upload. No account. No cost. Test it in airplane mode — every tool still works.

records.name: FlowDesk CRM
records.tagline: Fast, clean CRM to track leads, deals and tasks
records.description: FlowDesk is a fast, clean CRM that helps small sales teams stay on top of every lead and deal. - Track leads, contacts and accounts in one place - Move deals through a Kanban pipeline - Assign tasks and follow up on time - See live updates and a clear sales dashboard - Role-based access for admins and team members - Works on web and Android Early teams get 3 months free in exchange for honest feedback.

records.name: Tapply
records.tagline: Build Telegram Mini Apps and AI bots without code
records.description: Tapply is an all-in-one no-code platform for creating and launching Telegram Mini Apps and AI-powered bots. Build interactive apps with a visual editor, choose from ready-made templates, design intelligent bot conversations, automate bookings and lead collection, and connect external services. Manage clients, accept payments, and publish directly to Telegram - all from one workspace. Built for creators, entrepreneurs, and businesses. Start free, no coding required.

records.name: Ship Your Pod free clip finder
records.tagline: Find the 3 best clip moments in any podcast episode, free
records.description: Type your podcast's name or paste an episode link. We read the whole episode and email you the 3 moments worth clipping, with timestamps and why each works, within the hour. Free. Want it done for you? Ship Your Pod clips every episode.

records.name: InterestCalcHub
records.tagline: Free Compound Interest Calculator with Growth Chart
records.description: InterestCalcHub is a free online compound interest calculator that shows how your money grows over time with monthly contributions, an interactive growth chart and a year-by-year breakdown. It also includes SIP and loan EMI calculators. No signup, no fees — instant results right in your browser.

records.name: JapanesePal — Free AI Speaking Partner
records.tagline: voice or text practice, instant feedback on pronunciation
records.description: JapanesePal is a free AI Japanese conversation practice platform that helps you speak more confidently through real-life role-plays. Instead of isolated flashcards or scripts, you practice practical situations — restaurants, trains, hotels, daily small talk, work, study, and culture-inspired conversations — with an AI partner available anytime. Perfect for AI Japanese speaking practice, language learning, and Japanese fluency. Start free today!

records.name: PHASI
records.tagline: Project planning built around what you're building

records.name: Erecta Switch 10-782-PP
records.tagline: Compac Engineering - Erecta Switch 10-782-PP
records.description: 10-782-PP Erecta Switch Polypropylene Vertical Level Switch. The 10-782-PP Level Switch is a versatile and reliable device that can detect liquid level changes in various applications. Whether you need to monitor water, soap, or light acid levels, this switch can handle it. It uses a magnetic float and a reed switch to convert motion into an electrical signal. You can easily adjust the switch to open or close on rise by reversing the float.

records.name: Cloudflare Clairic
records.tagline: Cloudflare's AI model for fast, cheap data extraction
records.description: Clairic is Cloudflare's new AI model for extracting structured information without generating tokens. Give it messy text or images, and it returns typed values like names, dates, amounts, calculations, and estimates in a single pass, with confidence scores. Built for developers who need faster, cheaper data processing than traditional LLM calls. Available in preview on Workers AI at $0.10 per million input tokens, with open weights planned.

records.name: DotMD
records.tagline: Review your AI agent's Markdown specs like a pull request
records.description: Your AI agents write the specs, plans and docs. Also a fast reader and editor: Mermaid, math, code, version history, search, PDF export. Everything stays on your Mac. Free to read.

records.name: Product Hunt Visual Launch Editor
records.tagline: See your launch as you build it
records.description: See your Product Hunt launch come to life as you build it! The new visual editor lets you edit your launch in fewer steps while while automatically saving your draft. A checklist shows what's required and what will help your launch stand out, and clicking a checklist item will take you straight to the field that needs work. Drafts, scheduled launches and live launches now all use the same editor.

records.name: Dots
records.tagline: A customizable workspace built into your Mac's notch
records.description: Meet Dots, a customizable workspace built into your Mac's notch. Most notch apps focus on music and notifications. Watch videos while working, take scrolling screenshots, use voice commands, and more. Whether you're studying, coding, or creating, Dots adapts to your workflow. Free to get started. No subscriptions.

records.name: Termi Protocol
records.tagline: Watch AI agents code in 3D and hand off the work
records.description: Termi is a 3D room where your real coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, OpenCode and more) work at their own desks. You watch every file read, command and edit live, not a scrolling log. New since our first launch: when an agent hits a usage, rate or context limit, Termi saves its goal, changed files, errors and todos, then hands the work to an agent on another model. A boss agent splits one goal across your team. Deleted agents go to a trash. Now on macOS, Windows and Linux.

records.name: Gerty
records.tagline: Private ChatGPT alternative that sets itself up on your Mac
records.description: Gerty is a private AI assistant that runs entirely on your Mac. It measures your Mac, picks the best open models for each job (chat, writing, code, understanding and making pictures), downloads them and sets them up as one assistant. No terminal, no setup. It works with your documents, mail and calendar, you can ask it out loud, and it shows you every change before it makes it. No account, no cloud, works offline. CHF 49 once for 3 Macs, 7-day free trial.

records.name: FLUX 3 Max
records.tagline: fal’s FLUX 3 Max: 10-second AI video in about 12 seconds
records.description: FLUX 3 Max is fal’s post-trained text-to-video and image-to-video model, built with Black Forest Labs on the FLUX 3 base. fal says it generates a 10-second 720p clip in about 12 seconds, around 10x faster than FLUX 3. It is tied for #1 on a preliminary Artificial Analysis image-to-video board. Pricing is $0.0425 per second of video through November 7 (list $0.17), with a playground and API.

records.name: MOVO AI
records.tagline: The world's first long-form video agent for mobile
records.description: MOVO AI is the world’s first AI video agent for long-form creation that works right from your phone. It also works on the web. Shoot, upload, or start with an idea, then tell MOVO AI what you want. MOVO plans, creates, refines, keeps characters and scenes consistent, and brings the whole video together. Lock your phone and MOVO keeps working. Come back to review or make changes through chat. No prompt gymnastics. No canvas-heavy workflows. No manual clip stitching.

records.name: Peras
records.tagline: Pause Claude Code and Codex before they burn your week
records.description: Peras puts a line in your Claude Code and Codex week. Set it (peras set weekly 85 pause) and once usage crosses it, the agent's next tool call is refused with a plain reason, so one long task can't burn the rest of your week. Resume whenever you want, from the terminal or the menu bar. Opt-in: your agents can be told their own usage. The CLI and hooks are free and MIT. The native Mac menu bar app is €4.99 once.

records.name: ElevenLabs Realtime
records.tagline: Realtime voice agent models with 570ms to first audio
records.description: Eleven Realtime is ElevenLabs’ new family of speech-to-speech models for voice agents. Speech recognition, turn-taking, the LLM and the voice are tuned end-to-end. v1 Mini is built for natural conversation, v1 Max for complex tasks, with 620ms and 570ms to first audio. It supports 90+ languages and works in ElevenAgents or through an OpenAI-compatible Realtime API, so you only change the endpoint and model name.

records.name: Inyon
records.tagline: Answer your coding agents from your phone
records.description: Inyon shows the coding agents already running in tmux on your machines (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Copilot CLI, Antigravity) as chats on your phone or in a browser. When one asks something, you answer with a tap and it's typed into the same pane, so nothing changes when you sit back down. No account and nothing to host: pair the Android app by QR code and it reaches your computers over an end-to-end encrypted tunnel or your VPN. Free, open source, MIT.

records.name: MixBar: Volume Mixer & EQ
records.tagline: Per-app audio & sound control
records.description: Give every app its own volume — and its own sound. MixBar is a native menu bar mixer for macOS. Every running app gets a real volume slider, its own output device and its own equalizer, so your music, meetings and browser stop fighting over one system volume. It also includes 4,000+ calibrated headphone EQ profiles. There is no audio driver to install: MixBar uses the audio taps built into macOS, and audio is never recorded or sent anywhere.

records.name: EnLup
records.tagline: Turn YouTube into your English classroom
records.description: Learn English from the YouTube videos and podcasts you enjoy. EnLup brings bilingual subtitles, instant word lookup, and a personal wordbook into one study flow. Save words in context, then practise them with quizzes, spelling, and speaking drills. Start free in your browser.

records.name: Filomou: Lean languages
records.tagline: Learn languages by talking on calls with AI
records.description: Filomou is a language learning app where an AI friend phones you in the language you're learning. Pick your call window, just talk, and tap any word you don't know. Each friend remembers you between calls. 14 languages, iOS and Android, pay for minutes you talk.

records.name: Mingzi
records.tagline: Explore real Chinese names and write yours in Chinese
records.description: Mingzi helps people outside China explore Chinese names and find one that sounds natural. Browse 130+ real given names and the 100 most common surnames, each with characters, pinyin, what every character means and audio pronunciation. Convert your English name to its standard Chinese form, or generate random names that pair a real surname with a real given name.

records.name: Backlink Agent
records.tagline: BacklinkAgen Get the Backlinks Your Competitors Already Have
records.description: BacklinkAgent is a competitor backlink analysis and link building platform for SaaS marketers and SEO professionals. It shows you where your competitors get their backlinks. It finds the articles, roundups and resource pages that already mention brands in your space. Then it helps you reach out to those sites and get listed alongside them. Your pitches, follow-ups and live links all stay in one place, making it easy to track every campaign.

records.name: KernelCash Budgeting
records.tagline: Bringing privacy and simplicity back to online budgeting
records.description: KernelCash is a new take on privacy first budgeting that requires minimal setup to get started. With KernelCash, you can create a budget, upload your transactions, and start tracking your spending in minutes. Want your spouse, family members, or others to budget with you? Invite as many collaborators to your space as you would like! We take pride in our strict stance against connecting to our user's bank accounts. With KernelCash, you are always in the drivers seat when it comes to your data!

records.name: Google Index Checker API by SpeedyIndex
records.tagline: Bulk Google index check via REST API, up to 100k URLs/task
records.description: Check whether URLs are indexed in Google in bulk, straight from your own code. The SpeedyIndex REST API v2 returns Indexed / Not Indexed for every URL, plus the live Title tag for indexed pages. Up to 100,000 URLs per task, with client examples for Python, PHP and Node.js. API access is free on every account; checks are paid with tokens that don't expire. Also available in the web app and Telegram bot. New accounts get 100 free tokens.

records.name: WohSend
records.tagline: File transfer with zero compression and no data selling
records.description: WohSend is a European file sharing service that delivers files byte-for-byte identical to the original. No compression, no quality loss. Key features: • Zero compression photos keep EXIF, videos stay 4K • EU storage on Cloudflare under Portuguese law • Optional end-to-end encryption • Upload Method for TikTok/Instagram preserves video quality via metadata manipulation • Free tier up to 30GB with account • No ads, no data selling Built as a privacy-first alternative to WeTransfer and Google Drive

records.name: EsAI Video Stitching
records.tagline: Combine AI-generated and any video clips in one place
records.description: Combine video clips into one finished video. Use AI-generated clips or videos from any other source. Choose the aspect ratio for your platform and bring separate scenes together in one place. Simple online video stitching for creators, social media, and AI video workflows.

records.name: My Midlife Story: Menopause
records.tagline: Log perimenopause symptoms, walk in with a one-page brief
records.description: My Midlife Story logs hot flashes, night sweats, sleep, brain fog and mood in one tap, with space for your own words, and filters by 7, 30 or 90 days. It turns the notes you choose into an editable one-page visit brief and PDF with your main concern and up to three questions, and every line links to your original note. Later notes never overwrite earlier ones. Free logging, search and PDF briefs, with no account, no ads and no tracking. It doesn't diagnose.

records.name: Umbra
records.tagline: The infinite canvas that replaces your subscription stack.

Instead of switching tabs and paying for 5+ SaaS subscriptions, you get realdocx editors,xlsx spreadsheets, native PDF signing, kanban boards, and presentations. Your files stay on your disk, collaboration is end-to-end encrypted, and an integrated AI bridge lets local agents build boards with you. For students, engineers, planners and more.

records.name: Flow Free Connect
records.tagline: Connect the Dots
records.description: Flow Free Connect is the addictive puzzle game that challenges your brain! Connect matching colored dots with pipes to create a flow. Pair all colors and cover the entire board to solve each puzzle. Features: • 500+ handcrafted levels across multiple difficulty packs • Daily challenges for fresh puzzles every day • Smooth, satisfying gameplay with beautiful animations • Progressive difficulty from beginner to expert Start with simple 5x5 grids and work your way up to complex 9x9 challenges.

records.name: HeyResume
records.tagline: Free career tools to help you land more interviews

From designing formations to managing fleets and flying shows, our hardware and software work together to turn ideas into stories in the sky. Book a custom drone show for your event, or create your own with our Spectra drones and Starbound OS.

records.name: Snapja

records.description: Snapja is the on-demand marketplace for verified creators. Book a local reel maker, photographer, editor or UGC creator in minutes, track them live like a cab, and pay only when you approve the delivered content. 📸 ID-verified creators, upfront package prices 🚗 Track your creator live 🔐 OTP-confirmed shoots ⚡ iPhone reels delivered in 30 minutes, on site 💸 Payment held securely until you approve

records.name: NotaBill Artist

records.description: Create professional artwork invoices, receipts and certificates of authenticity with NotaBill Artist, the invoice maker for artists, galleries and independent studios. Selling a painting, completing a commission or invoicing a collector? Keep artwork details and sales paperwork together, then export polished PDFs ready to share. PAPERWORK MADE FOR ARTISTS • Create invoices for artwork sales, commissions and creative services. • Choose Artwork, Gallery or Collector invoice templates. • Include...

records.name: DepthTick

records.description: Customizable Windows desktop clock with glass styling and wallpaper depth effects. On supported wallpapers, foreground objects can appear in front of the clock, making the time feel part of the scene. Features Prism, Blur, and Transparent styles. Automatic depth-mask generation. Adjustable clock depth and foreground overlap. Custom fonts, size, height, colors, and opacity. Configurable highlights, refraction and shadows. Drag positioning, alignment controls, and click-through mode.

records.name: ExamBhai

records.description: ExamBhai is a free, privacy-first speed math & revision platform for competitive exams (CAT, IIT JEE, NEET, Bank PO, SSC). Turn idle study moments into 60s micro-sprints: • Vedic math shortcuts, %-fraction drills & number series • NCERT line-by-line formula flashcards & PYQ recall • Library Stealth Mode for silent reading room practice • 100% private, offline-ready local storage with zero ads

records.name: ScrollTax
records.tagline: Earn Screen Time by exercises
records.description: Convert footsteps and camera-verified squats or push-ups into Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube time. Zero shaking cheats allowed.Physical activity is equal to screen time

records.name: Five Elements of You — BaZi Calculator
records.tagline: Your Chinese element, decoded from the day you were born
records.description: Enter your birth date, time and place to get your Chinese Four Pillars (BaZi) chart, your Day Master archetype and your five-element balance — read in plain English. Rooted in classical texts, designed like an ink-wash album. No crystals, no lucky colours.

records.name: TraSignal
records.tagline: A simple and powerful way to work with SVG graphics
records.description: TraSignal is a social platform for people interested in financial markets. Discover community-created market analysis, trading signals, educational content and discussions in one place. With TraSignal, you can: Some creators may publish private content. Access to private creator content is only available when the required access is already associated with your account. TraSignal does not offer payments or subscription purchases inside the Android app.

records.name: RPG Character Name Generator
records.tagline: Epic fantasy names for D&D and stories. Free, no signup
records.description: Stuck naming your next hero, villain or NPC? This generator creates fantasy character names for D&D, tabletop RPGs and creative writing. You can filter by race, culture and gender, and choose full names, first names, surnames or titles and epithets. Generate 5, 10, 20 or 50 names at once, with no duplicates, and add heroic epithets like “the Unbroken.” Save your favorites, copy all, or export as TXT or CSV. Your settings are saved too. 100% free, no signup.

records.name: Wizstar Video Translation
records.tagline: Translate videos with real emotion and perfect lip sync
records.description: Wizstar recognizes 99 source languages and translates videos into 75 target languages with expressive, native-sounding dubbing, voice cloning and precise lip sync even for plosives, closed-mouth sounds, long vowels and sighs. It supports multiple speakers, side profiles, partially obscured faces and complex movements including people moving in and out of frame. Localize videos for global marketing, cross-border e-commerce, education, short dramas, and social media.

records.name: Hourbloom: Time Tracker
records.tagline: Billable hours in the menu bar
records.description: Hourbloom is a menu bar time tracker for people who bill by the hour. Start a task in one click and watch today’s earnings grow at your hourly rate. TRACK TIME • Start, pause and switch tasks from the menu bar, where the running timer is always visible. • Projects and tasks, with an optional hourly rate for each project. • A mini timer stays on top of every window. • Left your desk with the timer running? When you’re back, Hourbloom asks what to do with that time.

records.name: Custom Hat Boxes
records.tagline: How to Pick One That Keeps the Crown and Brim Intact
records.description: Hats lose their shape faster than most people expect, and the box is usually to blame. Custom hat boxes fix that with the right material, a size cut to the brim, and crown and brim inserts that stop dents in transit. Choose rigid for gifting, corrugated for shipping, or kraft for an eco-minded look, then add foil, soft-touch or embossing to match your brand. Explore sizes, styles and finishes here: https://www.premiumcustomshippingboxes.com/hat-boxes

records.name: Alathar — الأثر المرئي
records.tagline: Client albums, portfolios and photo promo videos
records.description: An Arabic-language workspace for photographers. Create branded client albums with optional audio, share a dedicated link, and control photo downloads. Build a customizable portfolio with contact and booking details, or turn photos into promo videos with Arabic fonts and editable templates. Free tools, on-device promo video processing, and a choice of platform storage or your connected Google Drive, subject to available storage.

records.name: AniDachi
records.tagline: Crunchyroll, YouTube & Netflix watch parties with friends
records.description: AniDachi is a Chrome extension to watch anime and shows with friends on Crunchyroll, YouTube and Netflix. Playback stays synced, with chat, reactions and voice/video calls right on the video -- no screen sharing. Friends join free.

records.name: PDF Workshop
records.tagline: Scan, compress and edit PDFs without uploading them
records.description: Scan documents, compress, merge, split, rotate, watermark, password-protect and convert PDFs on Android and iPhone. Every tool runs on your device, so contracts, IDs and bank statements are never uploaded to a server. No account needed and no watermark on your files. Free, with an optional ad-free upgrade.

records.name: $800 Gift Card Giveaway Enter Free Today
records.tagline: $800 Gift Card Giveaway: Enter Free Today
records.description: One lucky reader will win an $800 gift card. Enter free with your name and email. The winner is announced on this page on November 2, 2026.

records.name: MotoriLog
records.tagline: AI car maintenance log, reminders & fair-quote check
records.description: AI-powered car care app for owners and workshops. Log services, scan receipts, get reminders from manufacturer schedules and compare your costs with other owners. Ask the AI before accepting a workshop quote: diagnostics and a damage analyzer help you judge if the price is fair. Share a service-history report (PDF) when you sell. Workshop module: clients, work orders, WhatsApp quote approval, invoices. English, Spanish, Arabic. Free to start.

records.name: Monish
records.tagline: Your AI agents, live on your iPhone lock screen
records.description: Paste one line into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, n8n or any script. Your agent can then put live progress on your lock screen, ping you when it's done, and ask before it deploys, sends or spends: Approve or Deny from the notification. Free, no account.

records.name: ComplyTrackr
records.tagline: Never miss a CRA deadline again
records.description: ComplyTrackr tracks every Canadian filing deadline — payroll remittances, HST/GST, T2, T4s, WSIB — on one dashboard, with email reminders before anything's due. Built by a CPA who also holds the payroll designation. Free during beta.

records.name: Online mastering that explains each move
records.tagline: Music · Audio · SaaS
records.description: Auralith Forge measures your mix before touching it, applies EQ, compression and true-peak limiting only where needed, then re-checks the result. You get a report of every change, gain-matched A/B, codec preview and stem separation. 3 free masters.

records.name: Heelio
records.tagline: Monthly management P&L and cash forecast, from your books
records.description: Heelio turns the accounting you already keep (Pennylane, MyUnisoft, Xero or any FEC export) into a monthly management P&L, a 12-month cash forecast and a consolidated view for groups, even when subsidiaries use different accounting tools. Bank connections are read-only. Nova, the built-in assistant, answers questions on your figures and cites its sources; a read-only MCP connector brings the same answers into Claude or ChatGPT. Made in France. From €29.90 per company per month, 7-day free trial.

records.name: Hardly Working
records.tagline: Teams says you're away. You were just reading.
records.description: A free menu bar app for macOS. After the idle time you choose, it moves the cursor by one pixel so Teams and Slack don't show you as away. No clicks, open source (MIT), signed and notarized by Apple. It warns you with an alert icon if it stops working.

records.name: Watch Visitor Activity on Your Website
records.tagline: Watch your visitors sessions like watching movie
records.description: I have faced this problem which other analytical tools can't show you that you always curious about how users are interacting with your website, is there any blockers for users due to UI which are blocking them from taking any specific actions. Using VLP Recorder you can see every action, scroll, click, page change, form fill etc just like real video or real screen recording of the user (User screen isn't recorded by the way, the video is generated based upon recorded events).

records.name: MarocPros
records.tagline: Find businesses, professionals and services across Morocco
records.description: MarocPros is a Moroccan discovery platform that helps people find businesses, professionals and local services across the country. Listings are organized by city, activity and region, making it easier to explore nearby companies, compare options and access useful local information. The platform is built to improve the visibility of Moroccan professionals while offering a clear, structured way to discover services throughout Morocco.

records.name: NFL Schedule
records.tagline: NFL schedules, TV listings and calendar tools for fans
records.description: NFL Schedule helps football fans plan when and where to watch games. Browse by team, week, date or TV network, view kickoff times in different timezones, and use printable PDFs, CSV downloads and calendar subscriptions. An independent fan resource, not affiliated with or endorsed by the NFL.

records.name: Kucedr
records.tagline: One personal assistant. Unlimited tools.
records.description: Kucedr is a personal AI assistant that adapts to you and the task at hand. Write, research, code, or create images, audio, and video. Bring your files, choose your models, and make it work your way.

records.name: HY AI
records.tagline: Log your HYROX workout with a photo of the whiteboard
records.description: HY AI is a free app for HYROX athletes. Snap a photo of your gym's whiteboard and the AI turns it into a logged workout: every station, rep, weight and time. Track PRs on all 8 stations, see your race readiness against the official standards, sync heart rate from Apple Health, Health Connect or COROS, and follow other athletes to see who's racing with you. Built in Barcelona. Almost 1,000 athletes in under two months. iOS and Android, in English and Spanish.

records.name: CouchLegend
records.tagline: Track every show and film, and level up as you watch
records.description: CouchLegend is a free TV and film tracker that makes watching feel like a game. Tick off episodes to earn XP, keep streaks, unlock badges and level up. Get Up Next and new-episode alerts, know when your watchlist lands on Netflix, Disney+ or Prime, and send a friend a Recommend list they can save without an account. Import your history from Trakt or Letterboxd, and get a yearly Wrap. Free on iPhone and web.

records.name: DrillLock
records.tagline: Block distracting apps. Solve math to take a break.
records.description: Block selected iPhone apps, solve a math challenge to unlock them temporarily, then return to a block when time is up. Free: one rule and three 10-minute unlocks daily. PRO adds multiple rules and custom unlock settings. Requires iOS 17+.

records.name: DramaPlay - Watch Drama Shorts Videos
records.tagline: Short dramas. Big emotions. Stories that hook you.
records.description: Meet DramaPlay, your destination for short dramas and captivating stories you can watch on the go. ❤️ Discover romance and emotional twists 🔥 Dive into thrilling mysteries and fantasy adventures 🎬 Explore bite-sized drama episodes and engaging series 📱 Enjoy stories at your own pace, right from your phone From unexpected plot twists to unforgettable characters, there's always another story waiting for you. Download DramaPlay and find your next favorite drama!

records.name: LinkShelf
records.tagline: Find any saved link in seconds. Clutter-free bookmarking.
records.description: LinkShelf replaces cluttered browser bookmarks with flexible tags, instant search, and collections. Stop digging through nested folders—save any link once and find it in seconds across all your devices. Includes 1-click migration from Chrome, Pocket, and Raindrop.

records.name: Simply Sansu Trade Shows Calendar
records.tagline: Find trade shows and industry events in one place
records.description: A free calendar for discovering trade shows, conferences, exhibitions, and industry events. Filter events by industry, event type, country, and format to quickly find opportunities relevant to your business.

records.name: FIBO2 AI
records.tagline: FIBO2 Generate images, edit photos, and explore 541 prompts
records.description: Create images from a text brief or edit photos with up to four references. FIBO2 brings generation, editing, aspect-ratio controls and account history into one browser workspace. Explore 541 credited community prompts across 13 categories and adapt them for your next poster, product shot or infographic. An independent service powered by the FIBO 2 model.

records.name: Registros do Dia
records.tagline: Collect guest photos and voice messages with a QR code
records.description: Collect guest photos, short videos and voice messages through a QR code, with no app to install. Organizers manage a private gallery and download the memories. Couples can add a gift list with Pix payments sent directly to them, with no Registros do Dia fee. Built for weddings and events in Brazil, in Brazilian Portuguese. R$59 per event.

records.name: Fondays
records.tagline: One QR, and every guest's photos land in one album
records.description: Fondays pools every photo your guests take into one private album. Put a QR on the tables, guests join on iPhone or Android, and photos land in full resolution as they're taken. Dark Room reveals, live slideshow wall, co-hosts. Free for hosts until June 2027.

records.name: Monk.trade
records.tagline: Market research for AI assistants
records.description: Ask Claude or ChatGPT a market question and Monk runs the actual scan. Matches come back in the chat as a table and chart, with links to the filings and insider trades behind them. Save scans and rerun them later. Research only, never trades. Tip: start your question with "Using Monk,.." so your AI runs the scan instead of searching the web.

records.name: channelBar Feeds
records.tagline: News, podcasts & YouTube – optimized for iPhone Duo
records.description: channelBar Feeds puts news, podcasts and YouTube channels in one stream – optimized for iPhone Duo. Folded, the controls sit in the vertical bar at the edge; unfolded in landscape, the player shows chapters and transcript side by side. Podcasts come with transcripts to read along and search (if provided by the podcast), silence trimming, 0.5× to 3× speed and a sleep timer. Pairs with channelBar for Mac, Apple TV and Vision Pro. No tracking, no ads. 14 days free, then a one-time purchase.

records.name: Furnace
records.tagline: Check your AI-built app before users find the holes
records.description: Furnace reads your AI-built app and lists what's unsafe before launch: open routes, missing login checks, leaked keys, unprotected database tables. Fixed rules, no AI guessing. Your code stays on your machine.

records.name: ShiftConvert
records.tagline: Hold Shift, drag, convert. Private and instant
records.description: ShiftConvert makes file conversion part of your Mac workflow. Hold Shift, drag a file and choose your output format. Convert between supported image, audio and document formats without the usual extra steps.

records.name: Capbase
records.tagline: Free and Open Source Alternative to Pitchbook and Crunchbase
records.description: Capbase is an open-source alternative to Crunchbase and PitchBook. I know a lot of people are tired of paying thousands a year just to see who funded a startup, so I built a funding database the community fills in. It works like levels.fyi: share what you know and you see everything. Add a funding round or fix a company's details, and once it's approved every profile unlocks for 30 days, free. It already pulls in SEC filings, SBIR, Innovate UK, Companies House and Wikidata.

records.name: Muvia
records.tagline: BI, AI and ML for company data, industrial IoT for the field
records.description: Muvia connects your ERP, CRM, databases, files and machines, and answers in dashboards, PDF reports, alarms and the AI assistant you use. Every answer shows the query behind it. Python functions and models run on a schedule, in the cloud or at the edge.

records.name: AutoCloudPilot
records.tagline: Automotive deployment and cloud security
records.description: AI-powered cloud security and cost optimization for AWS, Azure, Google Cloud and Kubernetes. Automatically discovers cloud security risks, identifies wasted infrastructure spending and delivers actionable remediation recommendations that a human approves before anything changes.

records.name: Amoenia
records.tagline: Know if your retreat makes money before you book
records.description: Planning software for independent retreat organizers. Enter your costs, see how many guests you need and what to charge, then track bookings, deposits and payments as they arrive. Free for your first retreat. In English, French, Spanish and German.

records.name: Personal Learning Assistant
records.tagline: One digest of what you follow, ranked by what you'll learn
records.description: PLA checks the YouTube channels, research papers and courses you follow. It ranks each new item by what you'll learn and says why it made the cut. You get a weekly or daily digest by email and in the app, plus a learning plan you can track.

records.name: ElderMate
records.tagline: AI check-in calls for parents. A short summary for you.
records.description: Your parents' morning might be your midnight. Flights, work trips or night shifts can interrupt your usual call. ElderMate makes scheduled AI check-in calls and gives you a short summary afterward. Add your own call notes, such as asking whether a parent has taken their usual medication. They simply answer their phone—no app needed. Available on iOS and Android, with 5 free calling minutes to start.

records.name: CoreMVP
records.tagline: Everything you need to build your product. Launch in days.
records.description: The premium Next.js template with everything you need to get your product in front of customers: auth, Stripe billing, teams, file uploads, SEO, docs, agent workflows and end-to-end tests, already connected. Your idea, launched in days.

records.name: Reva
records.tagline: Everything you own, on one screen
records.description: Reva puts your bank accounts, mutual funds, shares, FDs, RSUs and property into one net worth, for you and your partner. Upload a mutual fund or bank statement and Reva reads it in your browser, so the file never leaves your device. It checks every figure against the statement before saving, and shows a dash where a number is missing instead of guessing. Reva is read-only, sells no products and gives analysis, not advice. Built for Indian households.

records.name: Roomia
records.tagline: Find Flatmates, Run Your Home
records.description: Roomia is one app for living with flatmates. Discover: find people and rooms that fit how you live. Sleep schedule, cleanliness, guests, food and noise decide who you see first. My Home: run your flat together once you’ve moved in. Split bills with Hissa, keep rent and house rules on one page, and see every change in one feed. When someone moves out, list the room for a replacement. Invite your flatmates with a code.

records.name: Ownwrk
records.tagline: A living record of your work, impact, and recognition
records.description: Your work is worth more than you remember. Ownwrk helps you build a living record of your professional value, independent of your employer. Capture wins as they happen or revisit years of work through writing, guided reflection, or your AI chats. Watch your career story take shape as your work history and summaries evolve. Keep recognition alongside outcomes, then turn your record into Highlights, exports, or a Shareable Page. Private by default. Yours to keep.

records.name: hilighter
records.tagline: AI skills & talent management platform for everyone
records.description: AI-powered platform to map, measure, and grow talent with personalized learning paths and skill intelligence

records.name: Dub Startup Program
records.tagline: Launch your partner-led growth program
records.description: Launch your partner program, track every referral, and reward the people helping you grow. Get 50% off your first year of Dub.

records.name: IconOven
records.tagline: Every icon your app needs: app icons and 85,000+ UI icons
records.description: IconOven is a small icon studio. Our app icons are ready kits for Xcode, Android Studio and the web: light, dark and tinted, every size, a plain licence. Standard is $100, Exclusive $249. Our 85,000+ UI icons come in 13 styles: Stroke is free under MIT, Pro and Max unlock them all, from $59 a year. Install from npm, Swift, Flutter, Android, VS Code or Figma. Free tools too: App Icon Exporter and App Icon Score.

records.name: Royaltify Studio | Music Distribution
records.tagline: Free Music Distribution Service for Indian artists & Labels
records.description: Releasing music from India shouldn't be complicated by international tax withholding and expensive foreign currency subscription fees. Royaltify Studio (studio.royaltify.in) is built from the ground up for Indian creators. Upload unlimited songs, assign collaborator split-sheets, get free ISRC and UPC barcodes, and reach 150+ global platforms including JioSaavn, Wynk, Spotify, Apple Music, and Instagram Reels in 24–48 hours with direct INR bank & UPI payouts.

records.name: Oxslate: Someone Remembers
records.tagline: Someone keeps the list. You just get the reminder.
records.description: Other household apps are symmetric: two people log chores and get measured. OxSlate is lopsided on purpose. One person keeps the admin (bills, renewals, forms). The other gets one calm reminder at a time with a Done button, and needs no account, no email, no list. They can pause, decline, hand an item back or disconnect, and the sender can't override it. No streaks, scores or read receipts; the data model can't hold them. Hold to talk for 30 seconds and get separate, dated reminders.

records.name: Artnap
records.tagline: 353,928 public domain artworks from museum archives
records.description: Artnap puts the open access collections of the Met, the Rijksmuseum, the Art Institute of Chicago and 65 other museums in one search. Every work keeps the museum's own record and licence. A Chrome extension shows one painting in each new tab.

records.name: PhotoToCartoon
records.tagline: AI cartoon generator for photos, in 57 styles
records.description: Create cartoon images from photos without writing prompts. Choose from 57 styles, including anime, Ghibli-inspired art, comics and pencil sketches. Download PNGs with no watermark, process up to 50 photos, remove backgrounds and upscale images in the same studio. Sample previews are free; photo generation starts at $9.99/month.

records.name: Framevolve
records.tagline: Make your startup’s launch video. Keep creative control.
records.description: Framevolve is a free-to-use motion studio for founders making product launch videos. Build with a coding agent, then refine timing, cameras, materials and lighting in an editable scene. Try the lightweight browser demo or download the Mac studio for local rendering. Free for personal and professional use; any AI provider usage is separate.

records.name: Beat Chuck
records.tagline: Free sports predictions with friends and leaderboards
records.description: Beat Chuck offers free sports prediction challenges for fans. Make your picks, follow public leaderboards, and compete with friends in private groups. A sports newsroom publishes coverage alongside the games. Contact: chuck@beatchuck.com.

records.name: Text Match
records.tagline: Newspaper-style text match cut videos, free in your browser
records.description: Type a word or phrase and Text Match turns it into a newspaper cut video: your phrase stays locked in place while the print around it cuts. 4 print styles, Google Fonts or your own, 9:16, 1:1 or 16:9, watermark-free 1080p. Free, no account.

records.name: $800 Gift Card Up for Grabs: Enter in 1
records.tagline: $800 Gift Card Up for Grabs: Enter in 1 Minute
records.description: Just a name and an email. Win an $800 gift card to spend anywhere. No purchase necessary, open until October 31, 2026.

records.name: Jaypee Greens
records.tagline: Golf-course living across Greater Noida's largest township
records.description: Official channel-partner microsite for Jaypee Greens, India's golf-integrated township brand in Greater Noida. Covers every project in the portfolio — Crescent Court, Star Court, Moon Court and Sea Court — with live pricing, floor plans, and a direct WhatsApp line for site visits. Built by a freelance web developer (itzajay.tech) as the authorised digital channel-partner presence for the township.

records.name: Polylane for Cloudflare
records.tagline: An AI on-call engineer for your Cloudflare apps
records.description: Polylane catches issues across your Cloudflare apps, follows the connections between Workers, databases, queues and storage, and investigates the root cause using your code, logs and recent changes. When the fix is in your code, it opens a pull request for review. Connect with one read-only Cloudflare token.

records.name: Auxilian
records.tagline: Free backend for your agents
records.description: Auxilian is the most seamless way to build personalized software, and it’s free. Most tools are a few tables with an interface on top, built around someone else’s process. With Auxilian, you just ask your agent. Describe what you want. Your agent designs the tables, links them together, adds records, and surfaces UI as live artifacts. Your team works in it from one workspace, with every change logged. Use Auxilian to spin up CRMs, job trackers, project boards, or any other tool you can imagine.

records.name: NoShorts
records.tagline: Block YouTube Shorts and set a daily watch-time limit
records.description: NoShorts is two free, open-source userscripts for people who want YouTube, just less of it. One removes Shorts completely. The other sets a daily video limit, shows a timer and private viewing history, and stops playback when time is up. Once you've started watching, changing the limit only takes effect tomorrow (no "just 10 more minutes" loophole lol). Made for iPhone Safari via Userscripts and compatible desktop browsers. No account, subscription, or backend.

records.name: ShogunAI
records.tagline: Your personal AGI on your pc
records.description: An AI assistant that remembers your work and helps with meeting prep, search, writing and follow-ups. Try ShogunAI for Mac free for 7 days.

records.name: Truvec
records.tagline: Find out why your RAG retrieves the wrong answers
records.description: Test embedding models, chunking, hybrid search and rerankers against your own documents. Identify what improves retrieval, what breaks it, and what it costs before changing your production pipeline. No provider API keys.

records.name: Eugenics, Euphenics, Euthenics Quiz
records.tagline: Eugenics, Euphenics, Euthenics Quiz
records.description: Eugenics, Euphenics, Euthenics Quiz

records.description: Read-only sports betting intelligence across connected data sources, with event context, alerts, watchlists and review workflows.

records.tagline: AI Tool
records.description: SocialSleuth offers a free online Instagram Story Viewer and Downloader. Users can anonymously watch current Stories from public Instagram accounts and download available photos and videos directly to their devices. No Instagram login or app installation is required. Free visitors can search up to 3 different public accounts per day. Optional paid plans offer automatic Story archiving, ongoing Instagram activity monitoring, and weekly reports.

records.name: Everabyte
records.tagline: Secure cloud storage and backup for everyone
records.description: Cloud storage should give you control, not take it away. Everabyte combines zero-knowledge encryption, automatic backups, secure file sharing, and team workspaces. One platform for your personal files, growing team, or business.

records.tagline: Uma experiência de grande operação, agora no seu negócio.
records.description: Do primeiro contato do cliente ao pedido finalizado, o SENHIO conecta sua equipe, organiza a sua operação e oferece ao cliente uma experiência moderna e profissional.

records.name: SpareScreen
records.tagline: Turn any spare tablet or phone into a Mac second screen
records.description: SpareScreen turns any iPad, Android tablet, phone or old laptop into a wireless second display for your Mac. The other device just opens a link in its browser: no app, no cable, no account. Works with old iPads Sidecar doesn't support. Optional touch control, and you can mirror any of your Mac's screens too. Free for 7 days, then $7.99 once for lifetime access.

records.name: CafeMitra Cafe Management Software
records.tagline: Digitalisation of the cybercafes across india
records.description: India's leading software for Cyber Cafes, CSC Centers & Small Businesses. AI scheme matching, encrypted document locker, Khata ledger, and simple billing.

records.name: Markling
records.tagline: Native Markdown editing, with files you control
records.description: Write notes, plans, and documentation in ordinary Markdown files. Markling offers source editing, Preview, Split view on wider screens, outlines, find and replace, and local Mermaid and math rendering. Export PDF or standalone HTML.
