records.tagline: From idea to finished video. Just chat.
records.description: Fablo is an AI-powered creative production platform that helps businesses generate, edit, and scale high-quality video ads through natural-language conversations.

records.name: vs cainan
records.tagline: Programe com velocidade e liberdade no navegador.
records.description: vs cainan code é um editor de código completo para navegador e mobile, com suporte a HTML, CSS, JS, análise de código, matemática, e integração opcional com IA para revisão rápida de projeto, tendo o modo texto uma API tudo no navegador

records.name: SSC QUEST
records.tagline: game
records.description: SSC QUEST GAME for students studying for SSC in kerala

records.name: Geez Super App
records.tagline: One app that turns group chats into one clear plan
records.description: Geez is a Super App that takes a group from “what should we do?” to one clear plan: dinner, game day, trips. Everyone weighs in, the group gets an answer, and guests never need an account. Free until Dec 1, then a subscription. Never sells your data.

records.name: Balkan Premium
records.tagline: Funeral Service
records.description: Profesionalan međunarodni prevoz pokojnika iz cijele Evrope za Balkan.

records.name: App icon Maker, Logo Generator
records.tagline: Generate icon & Logo with AI
records.description: Design a logo, app icon, poster or business card in minutes, no design skills needed. Logo Maker gives you beautiful, ready-made templates and a simple editor that puts every detail at your fingertips. Start from a template or a blank canvas, tap to change anything, and export a high-resolution image you can use anywhere.

records.name: Rewire
records.tagline: Lock in your routine: habits, focus and goals in one app
records.description: Rewire puts your whole routine in one place: habits, focus sessions, long-term goals, to-dos, a food log and reminders that arrive as real notifications, even when the app is closed. It is built on habit research. Streaks survive a single missed day, every habit has a two-minute version for low-energy days, and progress follows the roughly 66 days it takes for a habit to feel automatic. Free, no ads, on web and Android.

records.name: ClientFoyer
records.tagline: Client updates, files, invoicing and payments in one portal
records.description: ClientFoyer is a client portal built for freelancers. Share project updates and files with clients in one branded portal, send invoices, and take payment via Stripe. You can also see when a client has viewed an update or file, with per-file seen-at times and dated approvals, so follow-up stops being guesswork.

records.name: OnCue
records.tagline: Local-first AI interview prep and live answer outlines
records.description: OnCue is a local-first AI interview assistant for macOS and Windows. Tailor your resume to a role, rehearse with voice mock interviews, and get live answer outlines from system audio. Your resume and interview history stay on your device by default.

records.name: InvoiceMate
records.tagline: Easy invoicing for everyone!
records.description: # InvoiceMate – Simple, Modern Invoicing **Create, manage, and organize invoices with InvoiceMate.**

records.name: Flownika
records.tagline: Your AI-powered workspace for creating, scheduling, growing.
records.description: Flownika is an AI-powered social media management platform that helps businesses, creators, and agencies create, schedule, publish, and analyze content from one workspace. Generate engaging posts with AI, manage multiple social channels, automate publishing, create AI videos, and track performance—all while saving time, reducing tool costs, and growing your audience.

records.name: Fazzaa
records.tagline: Home maintenance services in Saudi Arabia
records.description: Fazzaa is a home-services app for Saudi Arabia, available on iPhone and Android. Its service categories include air conditioning, plumbing, electrical work, cleaning, pest control and scrap sales. Learn more at fazzaa.sa.

records.name: Turbo Games
records.tagline: iGaming game provider
records.description: Turbo Games is an online gambling game developer founded in 2020 and headquartered in Tallinn, Estonia. Development, game mathematics, art and certification are handled in-house, and the studio has released a new title every month since 2021. Turbo Games builds its own mechanics rather than licensing existing ones. Its proprietary Vortex format grew into a full product line and has since been adopted widely across the industry.

records.name: imgsize
records.tagline: Resize images in your browser — no uploads, 70+ presets
records.description: Free online image resizer for Amazon, Etsy, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn and 70+ platforms. Browser-side processing, no upload, no login.

records.name: Thurayya
records.tagline: The launcher that knows what you need, when you need it
records.description: Thurayya is the launcher that knows what you need, when you need it. Press one key and your apps, folders, files and sites are already there, learned from your day. Type in plain words, spell it wrong, it still lands. Everything stays on your Mac.

records.name: hovernotch
records.tagline: Your Mac's notch, alive: music, files and your coding agents
records.description: hovernotch turns your Mac's notch into a live island. Now Playing with artwork, scrubber and synced lyrics; AirPods and battery; timers, meetings with a Join button; volume and brightness HUDs; a lock-screen player. Drag files up to the shelf, search a clipboard history that skips passwords. For developers: approve your coding agent's requests, answer its questions and review its plans from the notch. No notch? It floats. No account, no analytics, nothing uploaded.

records.name: Petdometer - Kiwo Pet
records.tagline: Little steps. A growing friendship.
records.description: Petdometer turns everyday steps into a growing friendship with a virtual pet. Inspired by my daughter’s drawings, it features charming crayon-style characters, including artwork she created. Walk to help your pet grow, collect characters and decorations, personalize its space, complete daily missions, and track your steps. Its blend of children’s art, pet companionship, and collecting brings a cozy, personal touch to staying active.

records.name: Daily Strategy
records.tagline: The one thing to do today, from the news that matters
records.description: For CEOs, investors and founders. Each morning DailyStrategy reads the news that touches your company an market against your mission, and names one concretemove for today, with sources. It learns from every Ueful / Not useful. Free for 7 days.

records.name: Musecube
records.tagline: Every web tool, one keystroke away
records.description: A native macOS app that keeps the web tools you use every day in one window. Pick from a built-in tool store or add any HTTPS page, open it with ⌥M, switch with ⌘1–9. Free and open source, no tracking.

records.name: Hippocrates India
records.tagline: AI Clinical Platform
records.description: Discover Hippocrates, an AI-powered healthcare ecosystem featuring Aegis for patient-focused health information and report understanding, and Oracle for doctor-focused clinical support. Built around a vision of AI for Accessible Health Awareness.

records.name: India Tour Packages
records.tagline: India tour packages covering Rajasthan.
records.description: Explore India tour packages covering Rajasthan, the Golden Triangle, royal forts and cultural destinations. Find a trip that suits your travel plans.

records.name: product maker
records.tagline: Digital product maker
records.description: so this is the tool to create Digital products which you can sell and it is very easy to make and helps you to make and mainly creates it and also you can sell

records.name: Hirem0 - AI Recruitment Assistance
records.tagline: Recruitment
records.description: The AI platform for building and managing remote teams end to end.

records.name: Win $800 to Spend Anywhere Free Giveaway
records.tagline: Win $800 to Spend Anywhere: Free Giveaway
records.description: Shop, eat, travel or save it. The winner decides how to spend the $800 gift card. Enter free before the giveaway ends October 31.

records.name: AI Image Combiner
records.tagline: Combine 2–5 photos into one natural-looking image
records.description: Combine 2–5 photos into one natural-looking image. Bring people together, place products in new scenes, or blend backgrounds. Start with a prompt or template, refine the result, and download without our watermark. Try once without signing up.

records.name: Win an $800 Gift Card in October 2026
records.tagline: Win an $800 Gift Card in October 2026 (Free)
records.description: Our October giveaway is open. Enter free for a chance to win an $800 gift card. No purchase necessary. Closes October 31, 2026.

records.name: OurSpace
records.tagline: The social network with no algorithm — just your people
records.description: Missing the old social web? OurSpace brings it back. You design your own profile page, pick your Top 8, set a song as your profile anthem, and scroll a feed that's just your friends in the order they posted. No algorithm deciding what you see — just people, in order, like it used to be.

records.name: GroundTruth OSINT
records.tagline: The world's events, unspun, on a 3D globe.
records.description: GroundTruth OSINT is a free live dashboard that watches 180+ public feeds (international newswires, official releases, specialist security publications) and clusters the day's reporting into the most significant global events on a 3D globe. Every event shows left, center, and right coverage side by side, with a triage queue, per-event market impact, satellite imagery, and a free daily morning brief. Free public API and MCP access, no key required. No account, no paywall, no tiers.

records.name: Seep Cards Game
records.tagline: Play with mind!
records.description: Two Indian card games, one deck, played the way they are played at home. The khaat game, with its real rules rather than a simplified version. Capture the floor, build houses, cement them pakka so nobody can break them, and hold the card that picks them back up. The opening bid, breaking and cementing, a clean seep, and the under-nine rule that hands the baazi to the other team. New to Seep?

records.name: CHIPNG
records.tagline: One tap to connect your entire world.
records.description: One tap transfers your dynamic Link-in-Bio profile and verified vCard directly to their phone book. CHIP NG combines smart NFC business cards and tags with a customizable digital profile platform. Share your socials, portfolio, and contact info instantly—with no app required on the receiver's phone. Update your links in real time and turn every handshake into a lasting connection.

records.name: Foliform
records.tagline: Desktop book-making studio using Markdown & HTML
records.description: Write in Markdown or HTML, design a beautifully typeset book, and publish PDF, EPUB, or HTML editions with Foliform.

records.name: Pyre Fitness
records.tagline: Turn real runs into monster chases
records.description: Pyre Fitness turns real-world runs into a story-driven RPG. Escape animated 3D monsters in chases that adapt to your pace, progress through a campaign, and build your fitness with guided workouts and meal tracking. Discover nearby trails using local park data. Available on iPhone, with one free campaign run and one free workout to try.

records.name: LyricVideoGenerator
records.tagline: Upload a song, get a lyric video synced word by word
records.description: Drop in an MP3 and paste the lyrics, or start from a Suno link. Every word is aligned to the vocal (forced alignment, not guessing), so the video follows the singer word by word. A director picks 3 of 59 typography styles for your song and plays them in sync so you can compare. Swap any of them, or change one by typing what you want, like "make the chorus bigger". No AI imagery: type, motion and your cover art. Export 16:9 or 9:16. Free at 720p, no account needed.
